items/arik's-vengeance-(weapon-of-legacy.name: Arik's Vengeance (Weapon of Legacy)
items/arik's-vengeance-(weapon-of-legacy.effectSummary: Arik's Vengeance begins as a Small +1 heavy mace (1d6+1) whose amethyst head pulses with dim light when held by a creature with psionic ability. It has three legacy rituals: Seeking Approval (present it to a priest of Aleithilithos or Sardior; 2,000 gp; grants Least Legacy), Gauntlet of Fire (survive five hostile magical fire attacks in one encounter, then fast and meditate 24 hours before healing; 10,000 gp; grants Lesser Legacy), and Final Revenge (slay a githyanki of equal or higher CR, then fast and meditate 24 hours before healing; 40,000 gp; grants Greater Legacy). Only psionic wielders can unlock it fully; psychic warriors need 2nd-level powers and BAB +3, while psions/wilders need 3rd-level powers and BAB +2. Psychic-warrior track: 5th psicrystal awakening; 6th -1 attack, -1 manifester level, weapon becomes +1 heavy mace of impact; cumulative HP loss reaches -2 at 7th, -4 at 9th, -6 at 12th, -8 at 13th, -10 at 15th, -12 at 18th, -14 at 19th; cumulative power-point loss reaches -2 at 7th, -4 at 10th, -6 at 13th, -8 at 16th, -10 at 18th, -12 at 20th; 7th armor of wrath +1 deflection AC; 8th vengeful tenacity +1 resistance saves; 10th +10 ft. base land speed; 11th +2 heavy mace of impact; 13th fire resistance 10; 14th manifester-level penalty becomes -2; 16th +2 psychokinetic heavy mace of impact; 17th +2 githyanki-bane psychokinetic heavy mace of impact; 19th +5 githyanki-bane psychokinetic heavy mace of impact; 20th +6 enhancement Constitution. Psion/wilder track transforms the weapon into a quarterstaff and uses cumulative power-point losses of -2 at 6th, -4 at 8th, -6 at 10th, -8 at 12th, -10 at 14th, -12 at 16th, -14 at 18th, -16 at 20th, with manifester-level penalties -1 at 6th and -2 at 13th. Its abilities are: 5th psicrystal awakening + transformation; 6th Extend Power 3/day on powers up to 3rd level without extra PP; 7th armor of wrath +1; 8th vengeful tenacity +1; 10th awakened intelligence (telepathy, speech, darkvision 60 ft.; Int 16, Wis 10, Cha 16; languages Common, Dwarven, Undercommon, Draconic); 11th +2 quarterstaff; 13th fire resistance 10; 14th Empower Power 3/day on powers up to 3rd level without extra PP; 15th armor of wrath +2; 16th vengeful tenacity +2; 17th githyanki doom (+2 save DC and +1 damage per die for manifested powers targeting githyanki); 19th focused power 3/day lets the wielder expend the weapon's psionic focus instead of their own and it refocuses next round; 20th +6 enhancement Constitution.

provenance.role: full legacy ritual, cost, progression, drawback, and ability-table cross-check

items/arvoreens-amulet-of-aid.name: Arvoreen's Amulet of Aid
items/arvoreens-amulet-of-aid.effectSummary: This six-charge, command-activated amulet lets the wearer cast aid for 1 charge or dimension door for 3 charges. An evil creature wearing it gains one negative level that persists while worn, never causes actual level loss, and cannot be removed by restoration or similar effects until the amulet is removed. If the wearer ever attacks a nonevil halfling, the amulet crumbles to dust.

provenance.role: mechanics cross-check for charges, powers, alignment drawback, and destruction condition

items/bag-tricks-rust-129.name: Bag of Tricks, Rust
items/bag-tricks-rust-129.effectSummary: Removing a fuzzy ball and throwing it up to 20 feet creates a random animal that serves the drawer for 10 minutes, until slain, or until ordered back into the bag, then disappears; it can follow normal Handle Animal commands. Only one summoned animal can exist at a time and at most ten can be drawn per week. For the rust bag, roll d%: 01-30 wolverine, 31-60 wolf, 61-85 boar, 86-100 black bear.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD cross-check; corrects the captured rust/tan table swap

items/bead-force-130.name: Bead of Force
items/bead-force-130.effectSummary: A bead can be thrown up to 60 feet with no range penalty. On impact it bursts for 5d6 force damage to creatures within 10 feet, then functions as resilient sphere (Reflex DC 16 negates) with a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes around the target if it fits. The force sphere is impervious to damage and blocks passage in either direction while allowing normal breathing; it can be destroyed harmlessly by rod of cancellation/negation, disintegrate, or targeted dispel magic. The enclosed subject cannot move the globe by struggling. The bead is consumed on use.

items/bowl-commanding-water-elementals-2.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
items/bowl-commanding-water-elementals-2.effectSummary: Fill the bowl with fresh water and spend 1 full round speaking the summoning words to call one Large water elemental as summon monster VI. Only one elemental can be called at a time; new water cannot be used for another call until the first elemental is dismissed, dispelled, or slain. Using salt water instead calls a Huge water elemental as summon monster VII.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD elemental size and summon-monster level cross-check

items/brazier-commanding-fire-elementals.name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
items/brazier-commanding-fire-elementals.effectSummary: Light a fire in the brazier and spend 1 full round speaking the summoning words to call one Large fire elemental as summon monster VI. Only one elemental can be summoned at a time; a new fire cannot be lit for another call until the first elemental is dismissed, dispelled, or slain. Adding brimstone calls a Huge fire elemental instead, as summon monster VII.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD elemental size and summon-monster level cross-check

items/cap-of-befuddlement-746.name: Cap of Befuddlement
items/cap-of-befuddlement-746.effectSummary: While worn, activating the cap grants the wearer the effects of the awareness psionic power for 1 hour. The cap must remain worn for the benefit to apply.

items/censer-controlling-air-elementals-.name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
items/censer-controlling-air-elementals-.effectSummary: Fill the censer with incense, light it, and spend 1 full round speaking the summoning words to call one Large air elemental as summon monster VI. Only one elemental can be summoned at a time; a new piece of incense cannot be lit for another call until the first elemental is dismissed, dispelled, or slain. Burning incense of meditation instead calls an elder air elemental as summon monster IX.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD elemental size and summon-monster level cross-check

items/censer-last-breath-350.name: Censer of The Last Breath [Relic]
items/censer-last-breath-350.effectSummary: Filling the censer with gem dust and letting it burn creates a 20-foot-radius cloud centered on and moving with the holder; the holder is unaffected by the cloud. With 10 gp of quartz dust, it produces obscuring mist for 10 rounds, and a neutral evil, neutral, lawful evil, or chaotic evil holder can see through that mist normally. Relic power requires worship of Nerull plus either sacrificing the divine spell slot shown for the chosen dust or having True Believer and at least the listed HD: diamond dust 250 gp, 5th-level slot/9 HD, solid fog except only living creatures are slowed; emerald dust 500 gp, 6th/11 HD, cloudkill that hovers around the holder, Fort DC 17 partial; sapphire dust 1,000 gp, 7th/13 HD, acid fog except only living creatures are slowed; ruby dust 2,000 gp, 8th/15 HD, incendiary cloud that hovers around the holder, Reflex DC 22 half.
